competition_id_note: PWW competition 459 (the RESULTS sheet name as built); 2013 ICF Ocean Racing World Championship
title: 2013 ICF Ocean Racing World Championship
notes: Built as Madeira_2024_COR: kind WCH with the _COR key suffix (maintainer t123u says "the kind is COR"; COR is not in the contract kind list, question on the PR), discipline "ocean racing", domain "flatwater_ocean".

Scope: the six WCH SS1 classes (Senior, U23, Junior; men and women), each printed as its own race (Race 1-6) off one gun. Out of scope, not built: 188 SS1 Masters lines (35-69 age classes), 12 SUP and 4 OC1 lines of the same mass start (organiser overall results). SS2 (Sunday 14 Jul, "World Championship Demo Race" per the organiser Race Info) is not in the ICF results book and is not built.

START_DATE 2013-07-13 (Saturday): the organiser "Official Race Schedule" posted Wednesday 10 Jul 2013 says the SS1 race takes place on Saturday, i.e. 13 Jul; the organiser "SS1 Final Results" post is dated Saturday 13-Jul-13 22:45:52 UTC; the maintainer gallery EXIF dates (t127u) put the SS1 start and finish on 13 Jul. The ICF book gives the meeting as 12-14 July only.

START_TIME 16:30:00 on all 144 rows: every race header of the ICF results book and of the organiser SS1 PDF prints "16:30 Race N". The organiser schedule says "16h00 - Race start" and the gallery shows the beach start at 16:00-16:03 (camera clocks); kept 16:30 from the results pending the maintainer ruling (question on the PR). start_times "scheduled".

DISTANCE 22500 (metres) on all rows, per maintainer t126u ("Take whatever you see most realistic for the race distance"): the organiser Race Info prints "Downwind Single Ski - 22,5 km (World Championship Race)" and "The course will be 22,5 km of downwind". Unofficial reports give about 20 or 23 km; the results print no distance.
RESULT as printed, normalised to HH:MM:SS.fff; DIFFERENCE not written (ocean rule). BIB_BOAT = STARTING_LANE = printed bib.
Status: 21 boats print no rank, no time and "3" in the D column (race 1: 7, race 2: 6, race 3: 6, race 5: 2); no legend defines it, OBS left empty (obs_log), question on the PR.
The race 1 and race 6 winner lines print an extra time before the finish time (12:38.31 Sean RICE, 13:27.25 Teneale HATTON); not written (extra_times_log).
ICF ids: the results print no ICF ids. Ocean rule 3 / bind_seat by exact printed name + NOC + gender: 49 seats bound, 94 no_icf_id, 1 emptied (João SILVA POR, four ICF athletes carry the name).
Two Pedro ROLLA (POR) are printed: bib 225 (race 3, rank 7) and bib 287 (race 3, status 3); both no_icf_id; start list "Start_list_ordenada" also lists both bibs as SS1 Jun.
